column1: # Fights that one set does not answer, part by part. Written for this plugin (October 2026) from the page
# of each boss on the OSRS Wiki and from fights its authors mapped themselves. The first line of a boss is
# what the set worn is picked for; each other line is a part to carry pieces for.

column3: npc id of the part (0 on a main line: the boss's own row, as for a boss of one part; 0 on a part by name: no monster to sum against)
column5: style (empty = whichever does the most; spell = magic that is cast)
column6: note
column7: flags: nofigure (when the sums do not know what makes the part what it is), carryN (up to N pieces carried for it), when=melee|ranged|magic (only with a set worn of that style), str (pieces judged by strength, not attack), keep (pieces carried for what they do, whatever their bonus), sums (with none of its weapons owned, the sums pick the part against its monster), advice (on a main line: a note of advice, not said under a task's own rule)
column8: weapons by name, best first, separated by ";" (for a part the sums cannot weigh: the first one owned that the task allows is carried; a task that allows none leaves the part out)
column9: pieces by name to change into with that weapon, one piece a group, groups separated by ";", the others of a group after "|" (of a group, the owned one with the most; each carried only when its attack bonus of the weapon's kind, or its strength with "str", is above what the set wears in that slot; ammunition always)
